AboutPage.storyBody:
In 2018, we realized typical agencies had a problem: too many middlemen between the client and the code. Result? Projects that drag, budgets that explode, and frustrated clients.

We decided to do things differently: a micro-team of seniors who talk directly to clients. No salespeople, no project managers playing telephone. The expert who builds is the one who answers your questions.

Today, we're 4 complementary profiles: AI, Architecture, Design, Strategy. Each has 10+ years of experience. Nike, Clarins, L'Oréal trust us. Not for our size, but for our expertise.

agrement-cii.author: Jean Ashton
content: The Innovation Tax Credit (CII) helps companies fund a portion of their R&D and innovation spend.
Yodev is CII-approved as a subcontractor recognized by the French Ministry of Research, which means our services can be included in eligible projects.
We help frame eligible work, structure deliverables, and secure technical requirements.
If you're preparing a CII file, we can support you from the framing phase to maximize delivered value.

waf-efficacite.title: How to maximize a Web Application Firewall (WAF)?
waf-efficacite.excerpt: A well-configured WAF is the difference between symbolic protection and a real barrier.
waf-efficacite.author: Molly Allerhand
content: A WAF blocks what it recognizes. Poor configuration leads to false positives or missed attacks.
Start with observation mode and analyze logs to understand real traffic patterns.
Tailor rules to critical routes, business use cases and your sector's attack patterns.
Automate rule updates and add security regression tests to your CI/CD pipeline.
Measure impact: block rate, latency, false positives and incidents avoided.

integrite-logs-continu.title: Certifying the integrity of a continuous log stream
integrite-logs-continu.excerpt: Proving your logs were not altered is now a security and compliance must.
integrite-logs-continu.author: Molly Allerhand
content: Logs are evidence. You must be able to prove they have not been modified.
The approach chains events with hashes and periodically signs the stream.
Immutable storage (WORM) and timestamping reinforce traceability.
A well-designed pipeline enables faster audits and stronger compliance (ISO, SOC2).
We implement these guarantees on modern stacks without harming performance.

mvp-iteration.title: MVP and Iteration: The Right Approach
mvp-iteration.excerpt: How to build an effective minimum viable product and iterate intelligently.
mvp-iteration.author: Yoann Andrieux
content: The MVP concept is often misunderstood. It's not about delivering a sloppy product, but creating the simplest version that validates a hypothesis.
The key is identifying the core value of your product. What makes it unique and essential? This is the core feature the MVP should focus on.
Define clear metrics before launching. Without success criteria, you won't know how to interpret results and decide what's next.
Iteration should be fast and data-driven. Analyze user behaviors, gather qualitative feedback, and prioritize ruthlessly.
Don't be afraid to pivot if the data suggests it. An MVP that fails isn't a failure, it's valuable learning that brings you closer to product-market fit.

core-web-vitals.title: Core Web Vitals: A Practical Guide
core-web-vitals.excerpt: Everything about web performance metrics and how to optimize them.
core-web-vitals.author: Yoann Andrieux
content: Core Web Vitals have become a Google ranking factor. But beyond SEO, they reflect user experience quality.
LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) measures perceived loading time. Goal: under 2.5 seconds. Optimize your images, use lazy loading, and preload critical resources.
FID (First Input Delay) measures responsiveness. Goal: under 100ms. Reduce blocking JavaScript and use code splitting.
CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) measures visual stability. Goal: under 0.1. Reserve space for images and avoid dynamic content injections.
Essential tools: Lighthouse for auditing, WebPageTest for detailed diagnostics, and Chrome DevTools for debugging. Measure in real conditions, not just locally.
Optimization is an ongoing process. Integrate performance tests into your CI/CD and monitor regressions.

owasp-2024.title: Web Security: OWASP Top 10 in Practice
owasp-2024.excerpt: The most common vulnerabilities and how to protect your applications.
owasp-2024.author: Yoann Andrieux
content: Security is not optional. The OWASP Top 10 lists the most critical vulnerabilities every developer should know.
Injections (SQL, NoSQL, LDAP) remain at the top. Always use parameterized queries and rigorously validate user input.
Broken authentication is a classic. Implement 2FA, use proven libraries, and never reinvent the wheel with passwords.
Sensitive data exposure can be fatal. Encrypt in transit (HTTPS) and at rest, minimize stored data, and regularly audit your endpoints.
Vulnerable components are an often-neglected risk. Keep your dependencies up to date, use automated audit tools like Snyk or Dependabot.
Security is everyone's business. Train your teams, integrate security tests into your pipeline, and have critical applications audited by experts.
